issues.what: Saturn is bigger, sits lower and further right, and runs off the right edge. In -a the lit globe ends in a sharp terminator near x≈1250, with black night side and sky to its right
issues.fix: scale the globe down and move it up and left to match -a: top of limb near y≈55, lit edge ending near x≈1250, with dark night side and sky filling the right edge

issues.where: inner rings meeting the globe (crops A, F)
issues.what: -b shows a black, star-filled gap between the inner ring and the globe. In -a, dark C-ring material runs into the planet, and the ring plane casts a shadow band across the lower globe (crop A)
issues.fix: fill the inner gap with the dark inner-ring sweep from -a and restore the ring shadow band across the lower globe

issues.where: ring plane (crops D, E, F, G)
issues.what: -b adds bright moonlets and boulders sitting on the rings. -a has none
issues.fix: remove the embedded moonlets so the ring surface is only continuous ringlets

issues.where: ring color and grade (crops D, E, G, I)
issues.what: -b's rings are warm cream-gold with stronger contrast. -a's are cooler and more neutral, with grey, lilac and pink ringlets and a matte, finely grained surface
issues.fix: cool and desaturate the rings toward neutral grey-beige with pink and lilac streaks, and lower the ringlet contrast

issues.what: -b's bands are more orange and saturated, with busy turbulent swirls. -a is paler cream, with a bluish-grey band near the top limb and calmer bands with a few oval storms
issues.fix: desaturate toward pale cream, add back the cool grey-blue high-latitude band, and calm the swirl detail

issues.where: terminator and night side (crops E, I)
issues.what: -b has a broad, soft brown gradient into the shadow. -a has a tighter terminator that falls to near-black, with deep blacks above the rings at right
issues.fix: tighten the terminator falloff and crush the night side to near-black

issues.what: the orange halo at the limb is stronger and more saturated than the soft warm rim in -a
issues.fix: lower the intensity and saturation of the limb glow

issues.where: left ring horizon and sky (crops B, H)
issues.what: -b's outer ring edge is higher and more sharply curved, and the faint outer-ring haze line along the horizon is weaker. Its starfield is denser and dustier than -a's sparser one
issues.fix: flatten and lower the left ring horizon to y≈290, restore the faint outer haze line, and thin the starfield

issues.where: outer A ring, lower left (crops D, I)
issues.what: small dark specks show on the outer ring, and the fine sparkle grain on the ring surface is a little weaker than in -a
issues.fix: remove the dark specks and restore the fine glitter grain

issues.where: night side of the globe and ring shadow (crop E)
issues.what: the globe's dark limb below the shadow reads a little brighter, so the shadowed rings and globe separate less than in -a's deep blacks
issues.fix: darken the night-side limb and the shadow on the rings toward -a's black level

issues.what: the Milky Way haze is slightly fainter than in -a
issues.fix: bring the diffuse Milky Way glow up a little
